문이 5개(1~5번) 있고, 그중 한 문 뒤에만 자동차가 있다. 자동차는: There are 5 doors (numbered 1~5), and a car is behind only one of them. At the start, the car is placed behind each door with the same probability. When the contestant picks one door, the host opens 3 doors the contestant did not pick. The host knows which door the car is behind. From among the empty doors the contestant did not pick, the host chooses 3 at random (with every possible combination having the same probability) and opens them. After the doors are opened, the contestant may stay with the originally picked door or switch to one other door that is still closed, and receives what is behind the door picked in the end.

When the contestant picks one door, the host opens 2 doors the contestant did not pick. The host knows which door the car is behind. Only when the contestant initially picked the door with the car does the host choose 2 at random (with every possible combination having the same probability) from among the doors not picked and open them. If the contestant picked an empty door, the host, without opening a single door, immediately opens the door the contestant picked and ends the game. After the doors are opened, the contestant may stay with the originally picked door or switch to one other door that is still closed, and receives what is behind the door picked in the end.

문이 4개(1~4번) 있고, 그중 한 문 뒤에만 자동차가 있다. 자동차는: There are 4 doors (numbered 1~4), and a car is behind only one of them. At the start, the car is placed behind each door with the same probability. From among the doors the contestant did not pick, the host chooses 1 at random (with every possible combination having the same probability) and opens it. If the car turns up behind the opened door, that round is treated as if it never happened and is played again from the start. After the doors are opened, the contestant may stay with the originally picked door or switch to one other door that is still closed, and receives what is behind the door picked in the end.
